components.description:
_Calendar: the month grid that DatePicker and DateAndTimePicker open, one calendar shared by both. It sits in _Listbox’s Body and fills it. A part: place DatePicker or DateAndTimePicker, not this.

Anatomy: Header (Previous month and Next month as icon-only Text buttons, the month and year in Title/H6) · Weekdays (Sun–Sat in Body/B3 Semibold, on-surface-variant) · Days, six weeks of _Calendar Day, always 42 cells so the panel never changes height. month holds the header text.

States live in the days: set each _Calendar Day to today, selected, in range, outside or disabled. A range is two selected days with in range between them. Days before the earliest or after the latest allowed date are disabled.

Tokens: padding Element/pad-y-sm and Element/pad-x-sm · gap Element/gap-sm between rows of the panel, Element/gap-xs between days.

Code: the calendar menu inside DatePicker and DateAndTimePicker (.plus-date-picker-calendar). Previous month and Next month carry aria-label; minDate and maxDate disable days.
